يستمطر (form X)
# يَسْتَمْطِرُ (yastamṭiru) /jas.tam.tˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# يُسْتَمْطَرُ (yustamṭaru) /jus.tam.tˤa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْطَرَ (istamṭara)
# يَسْتَمْطِرَ (yastamṭira) /jas.tam.tˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
